definitions.gloss: street corner; corner of a town
definitions.explanation: A corner where streets meet in an urban area. Also used more broadly to mean 'around town' or 'in the streets,' suggesting an everyday urban setting.

examples.japanese: {街角|まちかど}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ばったり→ばったり：03701_battari⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I bumped into a friend on the street corner.

examples.japanese: {街角|まちかど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I had coffee at a café on the corner.

examples.japanese: {街角|まちかど}⟦インタビュー→インタビュー：03833_intabyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: We gathered citizens' opinions through street-corner interviews.

notes:
USAGE:
{街角|まちかど} evokes a casual, everyday urban atmosphere. It often appears in descriptions of chance encounters, street scenes, and public spaces. Composed of ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧ (town/street) + ⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧ (corner).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {街角|まちかど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧ (a corner café)
- {街角|まちかど}⟦インタビュー→インタビュー：03833_intabyuu⟧ (street-corner interview — vox pop)
- {街角|まちかど}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}かける→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧ (to spot around town)
- {街角|まちかど}⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧ (street-corner scenery)
